# The pond: open water between a near and a far grassy bank with stone edges. Up Z, the camera's side
# (the near bank) at -Y. Lanes of lily pads drift at world z 2.3 .. -2.3 (hedra y -2.3 .. 2.3), 1.15 m apart.
new
add mesh plane --name Water --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 17 6.0 1
apply --scale
material new Water --base-color 1 1 1
material texture Water base-color textures/water.png
material assign Water
# near bank (hedra y -2.95 .. -7) and far bank (y 2.95 .. 7.5), 0.3 m above the water
add mesh cube --name NearBank --size 1 --location 0 -4.975 0.1
scale 17 4.05 0.4
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name FarBank --size 1 --location 0 5.225 0.1
scale 17 4.55 0.4
apply --scale
material new Grass --base-color 0.220 0.718 0.392 --no-slot
material new Stone --base-color 0.337 0.424 0.525 --no-slot
select NearBank FarBank
material assign Stone
active NearBank
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Grass
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
active FarBank
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Grass
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
select all
shade flat
export pond.glb
